parameter: EIA 1.1 Air: NOx, CO, NH3 slip on natural gas (dry, 15 % O2, 70-100 % load)
remarks: ALP-EPC-00000-HS-DBR-0001 (HSE design criteria); ALP-IEC-10MBA-PR-HMB-0001; emission test ALP-EPC-00000-CM-CMP-0006 / CM-TRP-0006. Status preliminary until the IEC emission guarantee is confirmed.
value_text: The GT combustion system, dry-low-NOx, and the SCR with ammonia slip control are designed to the emission design parameters DP-CASE-0040 (NOx), DP-CASE-0041 (CO) and DP-CASE-0042 (NH3 slip), which apply from 50 % GT load and therefore cover the 70-100 % load range of the EIA. IEC to confirm the values in the emission guarantee data; SCR catalyst volume and ammonia injection grid sized to the slip limit at end of catalyst life.
